name: The Point of No Return
source:
„The Point of No Return“ is the story of Jennifer Turner, a mid-30's woman with a loving husband and a soon to be college bound daughter. Her idyllic smalltown existence is threatened when three fugitives decide to turn her home into a temporary hideout. Jennifer is faced with a decision: Cooperate with the intruders? Or resist them? How far will she go to protect her family? Are her actions going to jeopardize everything she holds dear?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DS23G]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《不归路》讲述了詹妮弗·特纳 (Jennifer Turner) 的故事，她是一位30多岁的女性，有一个充满爱心的丈夫和一个即将上大学的女儿。当三名逃犯决定将她的家变成临时藏身处时，她田园诗般的小镇生活受到了威胁。詹妮弗面临一个决定：与入侵者合作？还是抵制他们？为了保护家人，她会走多远？她的行为会危及她所珍视的一切吗？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/DS23G]Patreon[/url]]
